DECLARATIONS OF INTEREST

Cabinet considered several items of business at its Annual General Meeting.

Transport Committee member was Councillor Nigel Cooke.  

Councillor Shane Moore noted that the Hartlepool Council nomination for 
substitute Audit and Governance Committee member was Councillor Amy 
Prince.
